batches.objective: Identify a profitable general WGSL transformation using direct browser execution, independent of compiler delivery.
batches.rationale: Final archive delivery checks pass but assisted execution loses. Repeated direct-shader execution without any Worker finds identical-control variation and application timing sign reversals. Close the power-of-two performance hypothesis; no attributable shader gain is established.
batches.nextAction: Keep unsigned power-of-two rewriting unpromoted. Profile one existing independent inference or rendering application, identify its largest recoverable shader cost, and propose one general WGSL transformation. Qualify emitted text offline before runtime delivery; do not expand packaging or reselect favorable particle cohorts.
acceptance: Run all WGSL directly through the same browser with compiler requests outside measurement, identical inputs/geometry/numerical oracle, rotated cohorts and instrumented/uninstrumented scopes.
Reject gains explainable by identical-shader control variation, pipeline preparation or overlapping host work; preserve unfavorable cohorts.
Require a repeatable material complete-application gain from one general transformation and an independent workload check before promotion.
batches.stopCondition: Retain an attributable shader improvement or close the unprofitable transformation with evidence. No delivery or native runtime gain may substitute for shader quality.
requiredEnvironment: Ordinary WebGPU browser with observable adapter identity
Pinned WASM digest in trusted application metadata
Fixed seeded particle state and independent CPU oracle

batches.objective: Freeze a new full Doppler text-generation application contract and attribute a recoverable Vulkan execution cost.
batches.rationale: The UMAP binding-cache pass finds effective lower-level reuse and only a small descriptor preparation interval; no substantial recoverable binding cost is established. Close that line and retain UMAP as regression coverage. Select actual full Gemma generation instead of another isolated kernel statistic or a retired provider-comparison family.
batches.nextAction: Stop the UMAP binding optimization line. Freeze a separate full Doppler Gemma text-generation contract on Node/Vulkan, then profile model load, prefill, first streamed token, decode and final completion before choosing one correction. Preserve cancellation and resource lifetimes; do not inherit retired or Electron performance credit.
acceptance: Freeze the supported Doppler revision, real Gemma model/shards/tokenizer, prompt, generation settings, exact provider archives, physical adapter and independent numerical/stopping oracle before candidate timing. The new Node application contract is separate from retired comparisons and Electron acceptance.

Predeclare first streamed token and complete requested generation latency, loading versus retained-device scopes, median/tail material-gain bounds, memory/regression limits, sample order and failure policy. Confirm any candidate without instrumentation under matched Doe and pinned Dawn application work.
Preserve streaming, cancellation, resource release and output correctness. Measure compiler/preparation costs separately; keep unchanged UMAP and independent rendering as regression workloads.
batches.stopCondition: Retain or reject one application-backed Vulkan correction under the frozen new criteria; do not resume the closed UMAP binding or -O3 hypotheses.
requiredEnvironment: Pinned supported Doppler public generation API and real Gemma 3 270M artifacts
Physical AMD Vulkan provider and source-bound Doe/Dawn archives
Fresh independently reviewed Node generation oracle and workload contract
